senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; גָּרַשׁ)open space outside of a place.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 21:8">Gen. R. s. 21</cite>, end (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 3:24">Gen. III, 24</cite>) <he>למִגְרָשָׁהּ של עדן וכ׳</he> he drove him out to the open outskirts of the garden of Eden.
<cite ref="Makkot 12a:7">Macc. 12ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>אין עושין שדה מ׳ וכ׳</he> you must not change a cultivated field (outside of a town of refuge into an open space &c.
